mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4% over the past month signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <50% of instances where FEDFUNDS remains below 4% for the past month, or the 20d returns are not significantly higher than a baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the unemployment rate above 4% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days, reflecting expectations of labor market tightening and reduced inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 4% in a non-tightening labor market context, or the 20d returns are consistently below baseline during such crossings.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate below 4% and a sustained increase in GDP demand (GDPC1) above 22,668 billion chained 2017 dollars signals dual easing monetary and robust demand conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 4% AND GDPC1 > 22,668 (as of t-5mo value)
failure_condition: The 5d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both proxies meet their thresholds simultaneously, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the INDPRO supply index below 100 during a late-cycle expansion regime signals weakening production capacity, prompting investors to anticipate higher inflation and demand for risk assets, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO falls below 100 in a late-cycle expansion, or the 60d returns are consistently below baseline during such episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP demand (GDPC1) above 22,668 billion chained 2017 dollars signals robust economic growth, driving upward pressure on equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 20d are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 remains above 22,668 quarterly, or the returns are not higher than a baseline during such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment (PAYEMS) above 157,808 thousand persons triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting strong labor market conditions and reduced recession risks.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 5d are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS crosses above 157,808, or the returns are not higher than baseline during such crossings.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the INDPRO supply index below 100 triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, indicating weakening production capacity and potential inflationary pressures that reduce equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 20d are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO falls below 100, or the returns are not lower than baseline during such episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous surge in demand indicators (HOUST > 1,331 units) and a decline in the federal funds rate below 4% signals dual easing demand conditions and accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both proxies meet their thresholds simultaneously, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant in a regression model.
